Product Details
Unique E® - Vitamin E tocopherols formula
Promotes circulatory health
268 mg vitamin E per serving

For an optimum vitamin E complex, try Unique E® High Gamma Mixed Tocopherol Concentrate from A.C. Grace Company. This product features both gamma and alpha mixed tocopherols and 268 mg of vitamin E per serving. These mixed tocopherols are in their optimum portions to help promote the highest biological activity and maximum health benefits such as healthy circulation.

These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

Other Ingredients: BSE-free gelatin (capsule), vegetable glycerine, double-distilled and deionized water.

Suggested Use: As a dietary supplement, take one or two capsules with a meal or as directed by your healthcare provider. If needed, may be taken with liquid to aid in swallowing.

Warning: Do Not Use if you are pregnant or nursing, have vascular disease, are taking other medications, are preparing for surgery without first consulting your healthcare professional.

Storage Instructions: Keep out of reach of children. Safety sealed for your protection. Do not use if safety seal is broken. Keep bottle tightly closed. Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.

Country of Origin: Manufactured in USA

Other Information: No additives
